trace: Changi 1 used microfiltration, RO and UV and began first-phase commercial deliveries on 31 July 2009. The official opening followed in May 2010. The canonical Singapore NEWater proposal records first-phase service as adoption.

At Bedok, PUB and the environment ministry tested the integrated stack in May 2000. The project team dates first flow into the Bedok and Kranji reservoirs to 21 February 2003. These are separate dated events on singapore-newater-membrane-reuse. PUB’s overview explains the additional waterworks treatment before tap delivery.

The June 2002 expert panel report (§1.4) identifies why Bedok was selected: domestic wastewater made up more than 95% of the reclamation plant’s feed, consistent with the demonstration’s source-control design. The project team’s 2003 report documents the aim of supplementing raw water and serving industry.

Bedok's installed Hydranautics units and Cadotte’s earlier aromatic polyamide composite share a documented membrane family. The proposal uses an affinity link between singapore-newater-membrane-reuse and cadotte-aromatic-polyamide-composite-ro-membrane. Exact element, transfer and licensing remain open.

Cadotte’s November 1977 prototypes, February 1978 FilmTec refinement and July 1981 patent are separate events. The material proposal links the composite design to loeb-sourirajan-cellulose-acetate-ro-membrane as an improvement to the earlier thin selective layer and porous support architecture. The Cadotte–Petersen abstract and the independent Bend Research patent support that architectural comparison.

The 1959–1960 Loeb–Sourirajan laboratory membrane work and 1960 patent filing precede Coalinga’s 1965 brackish-water pilot. A canonical adaptation link on coalinga-reverse-osmosis-desalination is grounded in the UCLA operational research report and the Coalinga operators’ description of tubular cellulose acetate membranes.
alternatives: Windhoek’s New Goreangab plant commissioned in 2002 uses a direct potable reuse route with ozone, activated carbon and ultrafiltration as treatment barriers. WABAG describes the built process (https://www.wabag.com/project/direct-potable-water-reuse-water-treatment-plant-windhoek/), WHO lists the complete train without an RO stage (2017, Appendix 5, p. 77, https://iris.who.int/bitstream/handle/10665/258715/9789241512770-eng.pdf?sequence=1), and the city identifies WINGOC as operator in its July 2024 announcement (https://www.windhoekcc.org.na/san-antonio-mayor-to-visit-windhoek/). The city’s 2026–2028 technical adviser documents preparations to upgrade that plant and develop a second direct potable reuse plant (https://www.macsonline.de/about-us/news/detail/default-b780a61c1c); current plant-day production remains unverified.

A later Singapore adaptation uses flow reversal at Kranji. Orange County Water District reports a retrofit on part of the line and describes its own comparative pilot based on information exchanged with PUB (18 February 2026 board packet, Technical Exchange Program report, https://www.ocwd.com/wp-content/uploads/BOD_20260218-1.pdf). PUB distinguishes the planned Changi 3 system; the Kranji retrofit does not establish Changi 3 operation.
frontier: Read UCLA report 60-26 (October–December 1959) and 60-60 (July 1960), listed in Loeb’s collected-paper catalogue at https://www.desline.com/sidney-loeb/list.php, for the earliest working membrane tests and the documented relation to Reid’s lower-flux films.
Locate the Bedok demonstration’s equipment acceptance records or original membrane data sheets to establish the exact Hydranautics element model and manufacturing route.
Find commissioning and acceptance documents for Changi 3, and reconcile process design and guaranteed production capacity before comparing supplier and utility figures.
Find a recent municipal operational return for New Goreangab and original records distinguishing the first Goreangab plant’s opening from first potable supply.
screen: Checked canonical discoveries, their events and links, source register, all-eras frontier and leads. Reused the existing Coalinga case and left its output and cost chronology intact. Water Factory 21 is a separate Orange County injection project with a documented 1976 deployment. It was kept distinct from reservoir blending at NEWater. No matched Cadotte, Loeb–Sourirajan, Windhoek or NEWater discovery or lead was found at the pinned snapshot.
coverage: Evidence checked through 17 November 2026. The dated operating inventory is scoped to Singapore and contains a contracted replacement, with New Goreangab as a separate historical alternative. The proposal does not establish uninterrupted operating status or universal firsts.
